text:
pagerbot: URGENT: resv-pool-7 (dedicated) fully utilized for tenant AcmeGrocery. queue length 820 -> throttling. routing falling back not allowed for this pool. paging @oncall
sam: ack, I'm on it. starting investigation — looking at autoscaler + queue metrics
jess: seeing autoscaler logs: "scale_up suppressed: tenant_max_instances=12 reached". pool max_instances=12 in config
matt: also seeing a ton of long-running sessions from tenant research-sim in the same pool, many >2h. noisy neighbor pattern
sam: can we evict or shift research-sim ephemeral jobs? what's the business impact there?
lee: quick mitigation options: 1) temporary manual scale up of resv-pool-7, 2) evict non-prod/ephemeral jobs, 3) enable cross-pool spillover to hosted fallback (but data_isolation flag blocks that)
amy-cs: AcmeGrocery is live; they're already seeing 503s and delays. CS on call says they're escalating if not mitigated within 30m
sam: trying manual scale now: 
```
$ redwoodctl pools scale --pool resv-pool-7 --to 16
error: requested 16 > pool.hard_limit (12)
```
sam: pool hard limit prevents manual bump :/ jess any way to increase tenant limit temporarily?
jess: tenant_max_instances is coming from tenant-config-store. I can push an override but needs a quick approval and deploy to autoscaler service. creating PR now
matt: created a short-lived job eviction target: marking research-sim jobs with label "ephemeral=true" for preemption. command below — will cancel jobs older than 30m
```
$ redwoodctl jobs list --pool resv-pool-7 --filter "tenant=research-sim" --age 30m | xargs redwoodctl jobs cancel
```
lee: note: that will impact research-sim users. we should coordinate with their owners before mass-killing. alternative: enable spillover for routes with `allow_spill=true` — only affects non-PII routes
amy-cs: just phoned AcmeGrocery PM, asking for list of critical routes. they've shared route IDs and said allow_spill is acceptable for non-sensitive endpoints
sam: ok, toggling per-route spillover for the 3 safe routes now
```
$ redwoodctl routes update --route-id r-ACME-1 --set allow_spill=true
updated r-ACME-1
```
sam: enabling spillover routing reduced queue for resv-pool-7 from 820 -> 240 in 60s. latency dropped, but throttles still for some big requests
jess: autoscaler PR merged + deployed. override tenant_max_instances=20 for resv-pool-7 tenant group. watching scale events
infra-deploy-bot: provisioning 4 emergency GPU instances (prov-gpu-4x32) in us-west-2, ETA ~18m
matt: I'm starting gradual eviction of non-critical research-sim sessions (tagged). will log cancellations and owner pings
amy-cs: I'll draft customer comms/incident DM for AcmeGrocery and coordinate credits with finance
sam: note for oncall handoff: if queue > 200 again, escalate to SRE lead and consider temporarily routing more routes to hosted fallback
pagerbot: paging next-oncall: @jess will take post-mitigation watch. handing off in 20m
jess: taking handoff. will monitor autoscaler, pool utilization, and customer impact dashboard. creating follow-up ticket to review pool hard_limit and tenant isolation policy
sam: thanks team. postmortem owners: sam (mitigation timeline), jess (autoscaler limits), matt (noisy neighbor detection + tenant guidance), amy-cs (customer outreach)
